content: {DRAFT} In the context of Eth_MainFunction() , the following ac- tions shall be executed in the given order: • All SW queue shall be iterated and their credits account updated as specified in [SWS_Eth_00306]. 27 of 117 Document ID 430: AUTOSAR_SWS_EthernetDriver Specification of Ethernet Driver AUTOSAR CP R22-11 • All SW queue shall be iterated and checked for messages which are ready for transmission. • For each SW queue iterated, transmission shall be attempeted as specified in [SWS_Eth_00310].
